The power of its downward swing is in a class all its own.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 78 |durability = 35 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Savage Lynel Crusher}} Savage Lynel Crushers are [[Weapon]]s used by high-tier [[Lynel]]s, notably [[White-Maned Lynel]]s and [[Silver Lynel]]s, as well as [[Golden Lynel]]s in [[Master Mode]]. They were forged by Lynels using metal from [[Death Mountain]] and are known to have a powerful downward swing. Due to being made by Lynels, they are part of the [[Lynel Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} They are commonly used in the [[Eldin Mountains]] and [[Hebra Mountains]]. The Lynels who use Savage Lynel Crushers often swing the Weapon down to the ground, creating a hemisphere of [[Fire]], or use it to spin and knock out [[Link]]. They are wielded with two hands by Link, as they are incredibly long and heavy. It is among one of the most powerful Weapons in the game, having a base attack damage of 78. Savage Lynel Crushers are made of metal, and therefore will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, but they can be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. They will not be burned by Fire or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_018" |Life = 35 |Power = 78 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 8 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 15 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 16 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 30 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 68 |BuyingPrice = 144 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * The Savage Lynel Crusher is one of a few [[Weapon]]s stronger than the upgraded [[Master Sword]], the others being the [[Royal Guard's Claymore]] and the [[Ancient Battle Axe++]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Savage Lynel Crusher Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Savage Lynel Crusher ==See Also== {{See Also| * Lynel Crusher * Lynel Gear * Mighty Lynel Crusher * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Clubs, Lynel Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
